name: Displacer Beast

actions.name: Double Tentacle Slam
actions.effect: Attacks with both tentacles. If both hit the same target, the target is grappled.

reactions.name: Displacement Flicker
reactions.effect: When hit by an attack, the Displacer Beast can force the attacker to reroll the attack at -1d6 as its displaced image shifts.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.desc: The Displacer Beast projects an illusion of itself 1m from its actual location. All attacks against it have -1d6 to hit. This effect is suppressed for 1 round after the beast takes damage.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.desc: When targeted by an area effect that allows a save for half damage, the Displacer Beast takes no damage on success and half on failure.

lore: Displacer Beasts are panther-like creatures with two barbed tentacles and the ability to bend light around their bodies, making them appear to be a few feet from their actual position. They are cunning pack hunters prized by the fey for their hunting prowess.
